Shixin Shan 单仕昕

广西大学 · 机械电子工程Mechatronic Engineering · Guangxi University

我是广西大学机械电子工程本科生，同时修读计算机科学与技术。我的兴趣集中在机器人控制、运动规划与强化学习，希望从机械结构、底层通信到策略训练，理解并搭建完整的机器人系统。

I am an undergraduate in Mechatronic Engineering at Guangxi University, with additional studies in Computer Science and Technology. My interests lie in robot control, motion planning, and reinforcement learning, connecting hardware, low-level communication, and learned policies.

我开发过基于 ROS2 与 MoveIt2 的六自由度机械臂控制系统，并参与 RoboCon 四足与主赛道竞赛。在机器科学（RoboScience）的算法实习中，我参与机器人仿真、机械臂与灵巧手轨迹跟踪、多卡 PPO 训练等工作。

My experience includes a ROS2/MoveIt2 control system for a 6-DoF robotic arm and RoboCon quadruped and main-track competitions. During my algorithm internship at RoboScience, I worked on robot simulation, arm–hand trajectory tracking, and multi-GPU PPO training.

关注方向：灵巧操作 / 仿真与学习 / 机器人系统集成Interests: dexterous manipulation / simulation and learning / robot system integration

项目实践Selected Projects

Robot LearningPPO · Simulation

机器人轨迹跟踪强化学习

Reinforcement Learning for Robot Trajectory Tracking

参与机械臂与灵巧手的轨迹跟踪训练流程适配，涉及数据与资产接入、机器人状态恢复、参考轨迹回放诊断及多卡 PPO 训练。

Contributed to the adaptation of a trajectory-tracking training pipeline for a robotic arm and dexterous hand, including data and asset integration, state restoration, reference replay diagnostics, and multi-GPU PPO training.

  • 数据接入：适配轨迹数据、机器人资产与训练／测试划分，检查关节顺序和状态定义。
  • 仿真诊断：实现状态恢复与参考轨迹回放，排查初态、接触和并行环境一致性。
  • 训练迭代：接入多卡 PPO，围绕跟踪效果与碰撞惩罚开展对照实验。
  • Data integration: adapted trajectory data, robot assets, and train/test splits; checked joint ordering and state definitions.
  • Simulation diagnostics: state restoration and reference replay to inspect initialization, contacts, and parallel-environment consistency.
  • Training iteration: integrated multi-GPU PPO and compared tracking behavior under collision penalties.
PyTorch / PPO / Simulation / Dexterous Manipulation
Robot ArmROS2 · MoveIt2

六自由度机械臂控制系统

6-DoF Robotic Arm Control System

搭建基于 ROS2 与 MoveIt2 的机械臂控制系统，完成机器人建模、仿真、运动学求解及轨迹规划，结合 Servo 增量控制和视觉识别实现抓取任务。

Developed a robotic arm control system using ROS2 and MoveIt2, covering robot modeling, simulation, kinematics, and trajectory planning. Integrated Servo control and visual perception for grasping tasks.

  • 系统搭建：URDF 建模、Gazebo 仿真、正逆运动学与关节轨迹规划。
  • 任务执行：结合 MoveIt2 Servo 增量控制与视觉识别，完成末端微调和抓取流程。
  • 软硬件联调：通过 ESP32 与 CAN 通信连接电机，处理关节限位与奇异位姿问题。
  • System development: URDF modeling, Gazebo simulation, forward/inverse kinematics, and joint trajectory planning.
  • Task execution: MoveIt2 Servo control and visual perception for end-effector adjustment and grasping.
  • Hardware integration: ESP32/CAN motor communication, joint limits, and singularity handling.
ROS2 / MoveIt2 / Gazebo / CAN
